$comment: The critical user journey (CUJ) matrix that docs/multi-harness/JOURNEY-COVERAGE.md reads from. source: matrix (the original 22), newJourneys (design-v2.json), gap (added by the 2026-10-19 audit against Claude Desktop, the ChatGPT desktop app and MoPilot's own features). tier marks a journey in the gap list: A MoPilot's own features, B parity with the reference products, C lifecycle and robustness. specs are tests/e2e/<name>.spec.ts. Status per harness: Covered, Partial, None or N/A; acp is tracked for gap journeys only. tests/journeyMatrix.test.ts keeps this file, the specs and the coverage doc in step.

tiers.A: MoPilot's own features (the product moat): no reference product has them, so nothing else will catch a regression
tiers.B: Parity with Claude Desktop (Code tab) and the ChatGPT desktop app (Codex): journeys a user of either expects
tiers.C: Lifecycle and robustness: install, update, quit, crash, errors and running with no window

journeys.gap: Add a second account from the app (a new sign-in that lands as a new account), and the API key fallback once every subscription is out, on both harnesses.

The Code Review page is covered against a fake gh (cuj-pr-and-ci): my pull request listed, its diff and checks, Review in a new chat. Left: the team review lists, reviewing on Claude Code from the page (the default harness runs it).
Both reference products run work away from the desk (cloud tasks, remote control from another device). Needs a product decision on scope before a spec; until then it stays P2.

Covered on Codex and Claude Code (cuj-built-in-browser): the sign-in hand-off with Done, continue, the sign-in kept for a chat on the other harness, Take over keeping the tab. Left: ACP, a page that blocks the agent (bot check), Hand back.

Walked: Codex asks Claude Code, Claude Code asks an ACP chat, a chat switched from Claude Code to Codex receives a queued request and replies with every window closed, and an archived recipient shows Blocked with its reason. Missing: an ACP chat as the sender, the @ picker and the Message another chat dialog as entry points, and restart with a request in flight.

Walked: a Claude Code orchestrator keeps a task list, starts a Codex and a Claude Code session, a start on a missing harness fails with nothing left behind, the Codex session finishes with every window closed, and the woken parent wraps up by itself. Missing: Codex and ACP as the orchestrator, ACP children, the cap on sessions working at once, and offer / own_initiative cards.
MoPilot's built-in browser and computer-use tools from an ACP chat (only sage-mcp's debug echo is walked), and a switch back from the ACP chat to Claude Code or Codex.

Covered both ways between Codex and Claude Code (cuj-control-across-switch): the app grant and the site grant carry over the switch with no second card, and Stop lets go of the app. Left: a switch to an ACP harness, Your Chrome tabs.

Covered on both harnesses against a fake gh (cuj-pr-and-ci): Create (the in-app form, electron/platform/prCreate.cjs), Track pull request, the failing check in the Changes card, Auto-fix (from the PR's menu) sending it to the chat once. Left: pushing (the agent runs git push itself), review comments, merge conflicts.

Covered on both harnesses (cuj-preview-my-app): browser_preview_start asks on the Dev server card, the page opens in the built-in browser after the site card, preview_list, and Deny refuses. Left: launch.json configurations, preview_stop and logs, ACP.

One journey through the terminal panel, a command the agent leaves running and sub-agents: list them, open one, stop one, and keep them across Stop of the turn. Launch decision (2026-10-20): no new spec; terminal, claude-tasks and codex-background cover the pieces.

Covered on both harnesses (cuj-context-attachments): a PDF and a folder from the + menu and an @ file reach the harness in its form; a removed chip is not sent. Found #1719 (text typed right after an @ pick lands inside the file name). Left: drop, pasted screenshot (regressions.spec), ACP.

The global shortcut opens Quick Chat over another app, the prompt becomes a chat, it opens in its own window, and the tray's New chat and Stop work with the main window closed. Launch decision (2026-10-20): no new spec; mini and multi-window cover the pieces.

Covered (cuj-parallel-chats-and-status): a Codex and a Claude Code chat at once, Working and Awaiting approval in the sidebar, the approval answered in its own chat, the finished chat marked unread and notified. Left: ACP, more than two chats, the Priority list.
Connect a remote MCP server or connector that signs in with OAuth, use it in a chat, and disconnect it. configure-mcp covers a local STDIO server added by hand. Deferred after launch (P2).
Squirrel's quitAndInstall itself (it needs a signed, packaged build; the spec quits through the same before-quit path); composer drafts, which are kept for the app's run only; the ACP harness.

After the app is killed, a Claude chat whose turn it left mid-way reads as running in another app for up to a minute (#1744); queued messages and composer drafts across an app restart (not in the app yet: both are kept for the app's run only); the ACP harness quitting mid-turn with an approval waiting.

Sign in on a Codex turn that failed on its own lapsed login (#1745); a real network drop (the fakes model the harness retrying a failing stream); a Retry on a turn that already ended in an error (not in the app yet: Retry is on the running turn's banner); the ACP harness.

With every window closed a scheduled task runs (scheduler-no-window), a queued cross-session request is delivered and answered, and an orchestrator child finishes and wakes its parent (the two CUJ specs). Missing: the notification that opens the right chat, and any of it on an ACP chat.
Bulk import of many threads and sessions at first launch (paging); the ACP harness.
The daily chat loop with the keyboard only (new chat, send, approve, Stop, switch chat) and every control named for VoiceOver. Deferred after launch (P2).

outOfScope.reason: Image generation, Canvas and Artifacts, web search and deep research as product features, voice conversation mode and memory across chats belong to the reference products' consumer chat, not to a desktop host for coding agents. They become journeys only if MoPilot adds them.
